nodes.question: What are the risks associated with using high alkalinity and corrosive amine solutions in the proposed microalgae integration process?
nodes.answer: The high alkalinity and corrosiveness of the amine solution may be toxic to the microalgae cells, potentially affecting growth and system performance.
